integrity: The upper bound is a direct tensor-functoriality argument, and the lower bound uses the simultaneous universal witness in Tornes's Corollary 3.2. No numerical experiment, finite census, or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem recovers the completely bounded norm of the fixed coordinate identity from spectral-radius ratios over all operator tuples. It does not assert finite-dimensional detection of the supremum, attainment of the supremum, or optimality over arbitrary linear isomorphisms.
title: Spectral-radius distortion exactly recovers the completely bounded identity norm
